KBR.physical_anchor: None identifiable — revenue is government mission-IT/defense services and licensed chemical-process technology (ammonia, olefins, sustainable-fuels plants), not grid, nuclear, or power-for-AI equipment KBR itself manufactures.

KLAC.physical_anchor: Process-control and wafer-inspection/metrology systems used across mainstream semiconductor fabs — a real physical product, but sized to the whole logic/memory chip industry, not quantum-hardware fabrication specifically.
KLAC.value_chain_position: Broad semiconductor capital-equipment (yield management/inspection) toll-taker on the whole chip industry — no quantum-specific product line or disclosed exposure.

KLIC.physical_anchor: Wire-bonding and semiconductor/LED assembly & packaging equipment for generic chip back-end manufacturing.
KLIC.value_chain_position: Back-end semiconductor packaging-equipment maker serving the broad chip-assembly market; no quantum-specific exposure.

KN.physical_anchor: MEMS microphones/acoustic components and high-performance RF capacitors/filters sold into consumer, medical and defense electronics.
KN.value_chain_position: Precision electronic-component maker (capacitors, MEMS mics) sold broadly across consumer/medical/defense electronics — no direct robotics or quantum-chain product.

KSPI.value_chain_position: Kazakhstan payments/e-commerce/fintech super-app; no physical value-chain position in any FDT chain.

LASR.value_chain_position: Photonics & lasers layer — supplies high-power laser sources/components; overlaps quantum-adjacent photonics demand alongside its core industrial/defense laser business.

LFUS.physical_anchor: Circuit-protection fuses, power semiconductors and sensors sold broadly into automotive, industrial and electronics end markets.
LFUS.value_chain_position: Generic electronic-component maker (fuses/protection); components go into thousands of unrelated end products, no specific robotics or quantum chain exposure.

LMAT.value_chain_position: Niche vascular-device maker selling disposable/implantable surgical tools; no robotic-surgery platform or automation exposure.

LOGI.physical_anchor: Consumer/enterprise computer peripherals — mice, keyboards, webcams, headsets.

LRCX.value_chain_position: Core semiconductor capital-equipment supplier (etch/deposition); generic semicap exposure, not a quantum-hardware toll-taker.
